headline: Bitcoin is holding near $73,700 after hot US inflation data made a December Fed rate hike the market's base case; MSCI says at about 5pm ET Wednesday whether it will drop Strategy from its indexes.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko and alternative.me at about 04:00 UTC Wed 11 Nov (11:00 Bangkok; 11:00pm ET Tue 10 Nov). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 32, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 the day before

stories.title: Hot inflation keeps bitcoin near its lowest since August and makes a December rate hike the base case
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose faster than forecast in October. Bitcoin dropped below $73,000 for the first time since August, and traders now expect the Fed to raise rates on 9 December.
points: Prices rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per The Block.
Bitcoin fell as low as $72,643 on Coinbase on Tuesday, its lowest since August, per Forbes.
CME FedWatch odds for a December hike: 85% for a quarter point and 15% for a half point on Tuesday morning, per CoinDesk; 89.4% and 10.6% later on 10 Nov, per Daily Economics.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 15 basis points to 5.015%, per CoinDesk.
More than $632M of crypto bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, $511M of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by Bitcoin.com News.

sources.label: The Block: bitcoin tests $73,000 after CPI
Forbes: bitcoin falls to lowest since August

stories.title: Big holders keep selling: bitcoin funds lose money and companies trim their coins
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Monday, and ether funds had their biggest daily outflow in about a month. Public companies, mostly bitcoin miners, have sold billions of dollars of bitcoin this year.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $201M net, and about $1.5B has left since 2 Nov, per Farside data cited by CoinDesk.
BlackRock's IBIT lost $213M on Monday and $1.66B over seven sessions; US ether ETFs lost about $185M, the most since 6 Oct, per KuCoin News.
14 public companies have sold 108,247 BTC, about $8.08B, so far in 2026, per Lookonchain via CoinDesk.
MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1B over the past six weeks and plans to sell more, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk Daybook: ETF outflows mount, MARA sells

stories.title: MSCI decides today whether to drop Strategy, as bitcoin trades below Strategy's average cost
stories.summary: At about 5pm ET on Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok), MSCI announces its November index changes, which could remove companies whose main business is holding crypto, such as Strategy. Funds that copy the index would then need to sell the stock. Bitcoin is now below the average price Strategy paid for its coins.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov; changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
Companies at risk of removal include Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi, per KuCoin News.
Strategy holds 850,364 BTC at an average cost of about $75,456 each; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8B of outflows if it is excluded, per Blockhead.
Index-tracking funds hold about 13M Strategy shares, about 3.1% of its basic shares, by Strategy's own estimate, per KuCoin News.

briefs.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of possible charges
briefs.summary: The CFTC privately warned prediction market Kalshi it may face charges over how it notified the agency of new contracts; Kalshi called it a procedural error, per POLITICO via KuCoin News.

briefs.title: Miami-Dade to accept bitcoin for property taxes
briefs.summary: From 19 Nov the county tax collector will take bitcoin, converted to US dollars before it reaches the office, per WLRN.

briefs.title: Crypto stocks fall with bitcoin
briefs.summary: Coinbase fell 4% to $130.49, Robinhood 3% to $80.67 and Circle 5% to $64.29 after the inflation data, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: NYSE picks Avalanche for tokenized trading
briefs.summary: NYSE chose Avalanche to settle a planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform; AVAX rose about 5% in 24 hours, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Big banks fund a joint dollar stablecoin
briefs.summary: Goldman, Citi and other banks committed about $270M to a dollar stablecoin aiming to launch in the first half of 2027, per Bloomberg via Decrypt.

briefs.title: Polymarket says revenue run-rate tops $1.8B
briefs.summary: Polymarket says its annualized revenue is above $1.8B, up from over $1B in June, and its US platform handled more than $14.5B of volume in October, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: Securitize shares jump
briefs.summary: Securitize rose 41% to $9.86 after Q3 results, a Citi upgrade and a $50M buyback, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Bitdeer posts record revenue but a bigger loss
briefs.summary: Bitcoin miner Bitdeer reported record Q3 revenue while its net loss widened to $125.5M, per KuCoin News.
